summary: Glasgow navigation beacon may show bearing fluctuations between 340 and 020 degrees magnetic due to a temporary crane nearby.
text:
VOR/DME GOW/GLASGOW 115.40 MHZ CH101X THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS OF
DVOR BEARING FLUCTUATIONS WITHIN THE 340-020 DEG. MAG. SECTOR
RADIALS FROM THE GLASGOW VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO A TEMPORARY
CRANE IN THE VICINITY
